name: snow
summary: Lying snow: Devias's snowfield, its drifts, and the rime that frosts its ground.
why: Not grass, and the difference is load-bearing: ground.cpp sows the sward on every slot
whose recipe is grass, and Devias's two 'grass' sheets are snow.
Roughness 0.78. Fresh snow is a heap of tiny ice crystals, so it is rough at walking
distance but not as dead as dry sand - it keeps a soft sheen toward the sun, which is
most of what tells snow from white plaster.
Depth 0.14 on a cast grain, a little over sand's 0.10. MU's sheet paints drifts and
creases in pale blue; read as height they give the snowfield its soft relief. Much more
and the snow turns to crusted gravel.
Range 0.10. Wind-packed and loose snow lie side by side, so a snowfield varies more
